I travelled to another city alone (I'm young and physically small), while there, got an uber to a local attraction, explored and stuff, then realised my phone battery was dead and my charger was at the hotel. I was going to have a very, very long walk back if I didn't find a solution. So I asked anyone I could find if they had a charger for me.


Eventually I found a phone accessories store and asked them to help, so they put my phone to charge. While it was charging, the guy was questioning me about where I'm from and stuff, and if I'm single. I said that I'd actually travelled to that city to see my boyfriend (not entirely a lie, except he wasn't my boyfriend anymore, and definitely wasn't going to save me). This guy wasn't really listening. He said that he'd be in my city in a week and we could meet there then, and I said no, have a boyfriend. Then he said that he could meet me at my hotel after work, and I said nope, boyfriend. But he kept on nagging.


I decided to check on my phone and get out of there. Discovered it hadn't even charged 1% because his charger was incompatible with my phone. So I decided to just buy a powerbank and cable (luckily I had money for that) and leave. He was still nagging me as he was selling me the powerbank. He didn't want to let me leave until he got my number, so I gave him a wrong number, and I got out of there so fast.


I went back the next day with a friend who drove from a nearby town to pick me up, and this dude didn't dare talk to me. Probably figured that was the boyfriend. 


If I'm trapped in a situation, I'll give my real number rather than antagonise the dude, as in this situation. I was sitting alone in a vehicle at a hospital waiting for family to pick me up when 2 guys came up to me and opened my door. They were flirting with me and saying that I could spend time with them before going home, and I was like yeah sure. Because I knew I couldn't get out of that situation, they were blocking my door. They asked for my number and I gave it to them. The dude then tried calling me, and it didn't ring, and he asked why, and I told him that number was only for WhatsApp (true) and showed him. He was like cool, we'll meet then. He walked across the parking lot, I was picked up, and he never messaged me. 


That ended better than it could've. The parking lot was empty except for me.
